messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 INCIDENT P1 — Serving error spike detected in eu-west-1. Autoscaler errors + increased 5xxs. Pager routed to @oncall. Please acknowledge and declare driver/comms.
Jordan (oncall): acked. I'll be online for the next 40m — can take driver if Liam wants to hand off now.
Liam R: I can hand off. I'm on a train in ~15m and won't have reliable access after that. Jordan — take driver, pls. I'll stay as secondary until 18:30 UTC.
Priya S: I'll take comms (customer updates / status page) while Jordan drives. leaving notes in #incidents-updates channel.
Jordan (oncall): thanks — taking driver. quick status: CPU on serving-pool-3 jumped, some pods showing OOMKilled restarts, 502s from route-proxy.
Ruth: FYI cost-safety: autoscaler already disabled for this pool to avoid flapping. We should avoid mass restarts.
Jordan (oncall): plan: 1) triage logs 2) check recent deploys 3) revert canary if needed. Priya, if I start reverting canary I'll ping for approval before changing prod routes.
Priya S: ack. I'll draft a short customer-facing blurb: "We're investigating increased errors in EU; engineers are on it; we'll post updates every 15m." Will post in status page once we confirm scope.
Liam R: notes from my side: 17:02 UTC rolled model-qalpha v2.3 to eu-west. Canary traffic 10%. Metrics started diverging ~17:06.
Jordan (oncall): good catch. Runbook pointer: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/serving-degraded — see section "Canary rollback". Quick commands I'm running now:

```
# check recent events
kubectl -n serving get events --field-selector involvedObject.kind=Pod | tail -n 50
# tail logs for route-proxy
kubectl -n infra logs deploy/route-proxy -c proxy --since=10m | grep 502 -n | tail -n 200
``` 

Jordan (oncall): logs show upstream 502s matching v2.3 canary. Also seeing increased "guest token" errors from model-worker.
Ruth: If it's the model package, prefer rollback not restart. Reverting canary avoids full pool restart and keeps latency stable.
Priya S: I'll update the incident post: "Confirmed correlation with recent canary. Engineers are evaluating rollback." Posting now :writing:
Priya S: (posted) https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2026-03-14-eu-serving
ops-scheduler-bot: Reminder: incoming shift change at 18:30 UTC. Current primary Jordan, secondary Liam. After 18:30 primary should be Ruth, secondary Priya unless roles changed.
Jordan (oncall): note — I'm primary until 18:30 then handing to Ruth. I'll do an explicit handoff message once I confirm rollback status. Priya remains comms post-handoff.
Liam R: leaving this here — if rollback happens and errors subside, monitor for 30m before closing. If errors persist after rollback, escalate to infra-pager and tag @oncall-sre.
Jordan (oncall): executing canary rollback now (will pause traffic to v2.3). Priya — please hold off on status page updates until I confirm outcome.
Jordan (oncall): rollback command run: `kubectl -n serving rollout undo deployment/model-qalpha --to-revision=23` — watching pods.
Jordan (oncall): pods for model-qalpha are coming back healthy. 502s dropping in proxy logs.
Priya S: updating status: "Rollback initiated for canary; error rate decreasing. Engineers continue to monitor. Next update in 15m." :white_check_mark:
Ruth: I'll assume primary at 18:30. If anything degrades after that, ping me and I'll take driver immediately.
Jordan (oncall): handing off driver to Ruth at 18:30 UTC. Summary for handoff: cause = canary v2.3; action = rollback to revision 23; current state = error rate decreased to ~20% of peak, proxy 502s trending down; still monitoring shards 3/5 with residual errors. Open tasks: check model-worker memory spikes, confirm autoscaler re-enable policy.
Priya S: comms handoff to Ruth? I can stay on comms for the next update and then hand to Ruth if needed.
Ruth: I'll take over comms after your next post. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
Jordan (oncall): final — leaving notes in the runbook under "active incidents": "1789234567 — canary v2.3 rollback; primary Jordan -> Ruth at 18:30; comms Priya -> Ruth post-update." Leaving Slack thread for handoff.
Priya S: thanks Jordan. Good handoff. I'll ping Ruth at 18:35 to confirm.
incident-bot: Incident P1 remains open. Escalation policy unchanged. Next auto-check in 15m.
